cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a modern miniature railway museum's indoor demonstration platform — during an adult costume event she listens for the unseen model train; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a contemporary overnight train's small dining booth at sunrise — she enjoys a quiet pause before breakfast; a cobbled plaza before a Gothic cathedral with a fountain — holds her keepsake at chest height; a fashion runway under white spotlights — sitting on the ground; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing with one foot up on a step; her home kitchen with a counter — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds a smartphone at chest height
